meta.title: Manual continuation
meta.description: Continue an interrupted task from its original action position without replacing the draft or bypassing permissions.

checking: Check whether the continuation input was accepted
unknown: Acceptance could not be confirmed. No additional continuation input was sent. Activate again only to reconcile.
accepted: Continuation input accepted. This does not mean the model has started or the task is complete.
acceptedUnconfirmed: Continuation input observed; its durability checkpoint is unconfirmed. No additional input was sent.
invalid: Continuation is unavailable because the request could not be constructed safely.
reason.unavailable: the required live capability is unavailable
reason.busy: an operation is already in progress
reason.pending-interaction: a user interaction must be resolved first
